messages:
anya: Quick heads-up 0 onboarding friction: sample-app sets REDWOOD_API_KEY but our CLI and some SDKs look for different env names so folks hit 401s.
kevin: Which SDKs are mismatched?
anya: Node checks REDWOOD_API_KEY and treats tokens as project-scoped by default. Python uses REDWOOD_KEY and assumes org-scoped tokens unless told otherwise.
sam: That explains the support tickets. Repro shows token scope mismatch.
lina: Hmm. I thought we standardized on org default a while back but looks like env var names weren't consolidated.
kevin: Also the CLI precedence is messy: flags > REDWOOD_KEY > REDWOOD_API_KEY > GCP metadata. We need a single precedence table.
anya: Proposed immediate fix: 1) SDKs accept both env vars and implement clear precedence: cli flag > REDWOOD_API_KEY > REDWOOD_KEY > metadata. 2) Introduce REDWOOD_API_SCOPE env var to let local dev opt into project-scoped tokens.
sam: REDWOOD_API_SCOPE sounds good. Suggest allowed values: org|project|auto (auto = infer from token prefix/format).
lina: For parity action items: patch python SDK to honor REDWOOD_API_KEY and the precedence order, update docs and sample-app to set REDWOOD_API_SCOPE=project when onboarding for project tokens.
kevin: We also need rotation UX: rotation-bot should announce rotations with a fingerprint so SDKs can surface a helpful message when a token is stale. Perhaps add an x-redwood-error: stale-token header on 401s.
rotation-bot: FYI: automated rotation completed for infra-team 1 old keys revoked, 1 new key issued (fingerprint ab:12). :rotating_light:
anya: For detection, standardize a retry path: on 401 with x-redwood-error:stale-token -> surface CLI command `redwood keys rotate --replace` and fail fast. Do not auto-rotate in the SDK unless using ephemeral CLI-issued keys.
sam: I'll add a minimal handler in node SDK today and open a python PR tomorrow. Keep behavior conservative.
lina: I'll update the sample-app and docs with an example snippet and a Troubleshooting section: why am I getting 401 after onboarding? steps to diagnose scope vs env var.
kevin: I'll own a cross-repo PR to sync the precedence table across CLI and SDKs and ping infra to validate metadata fallback behavior.
sam: I'll create SDK issues and link to kevin's PR.
lina: I'll add a short CHANGELOG and docs note pointing to the new REDWOOD_API_SCOPE.
anya: Thanks team 1 /ping if you need design help on the error messages :thumbsup:
